$comment: Optional, runtime-installed plugins (ADR 0150 §7). Nothing listed here is in a
default build or a default bundle: each is installed by a person, pinned by
sha256, recorded in the plugin settings file, and off until switched on.
packages/app-core (the Settings capability); a drift test in each.

plugins.summary: Per-run proxy that lets an unmodified tool hold an osr_ surrogate instead of a credential.
Companion extension that fills a login field by reference from extension-owned UI only.
